question: According to press reports, secret peace plans for the conflict in Ukraine were drawn up before the 28-point plan1. The reports state that the German Government was already aware of an ‘Istanbul Plan’ on 4 November 2025. German and European diplomacy’s response to this has been cautious. 1.
Was the plan discussed at Council level?
Were Member States aware of the plan?
answer: It is not for the Council to comment on articles appearing in the press. As to Member States’ awareness of any plan, we would invite the Honourable Member to address his queries to the Member States in question.
